title: Action log entry
description: One entry of a campaign's action log (DEL-24, DEL-27, CAN-11), stored as YAML in `action-log/<id, six digits>.yaml` of the campaign workspace. Protocol version 0.1.0. A delegated action taken through the Core (`kind: action`) or a GM interaction on one or on a canon file (`kind: gm_interaction`), each counted in GM effort, a hand edit the Core found when rebuilding the index (`kind: hand_edit`), or a safe default the Core applied when a call's deadline passed (`kind: safe_default`), which is not a GM interaction.

at.description: Real time the entry was written.

moment_seq.description: The moment's sequence number in `moment.yaml`. Once the moment changes, the entries of earlier sequence numbers are frozen (DEL-25).

tool.description: The registered tool that took the action.

effective_level.description: Manual refuses the action: nothing is logged.

override_lowered.description: Whether an entity override of the acting entity lowered the level (DEL-12).

entity.description: The acting entity's canon id, as the tool declared it (DEL-10); null when the action has none. Absent from entries written before entity overrides.

agent.description: The acting agent, as it names itself; traceability only (ARC-22).

job.description: The job the action was taken for (job.schema.json); null outside job work. A job's action is bound by the delegation table of the job's moment (ARC-23).

runner_configuration.description: The runner configuration the job was started with (DEL-24, ARC-27); null outside job work.

occurrence.description: Present for an effect of the world-turn or a GM gesture on the living world: the occurrence key it applies (05-living-world-calendar.md, LW-04). Undoing an occurrence undoes every entry carrying its key and its cascade (LW-12).

op.description: Present for an action taken in the VTT: the VTT connector's operation (docs/contracts/foundry-bridge.md). Absent for a workspace file.

cites.description: Present for a disclosure: the ids of the facts it shows the players (CAN-16). Once it is applied, each one the party did not know yet gets a knowledge record, written by its own irreversible action entry with the same tool, level and approval, whose `source` names this entry (CAN-17).

whisper.description: Present for a whisper, a disclosure to one player: its `cites` mark nothing known by the party; at the wrap of its `session` each becomes a call on the GM, a party knowledge record held at propose whose `source` names this entry (CAP-08).

session.description: Present with `whisper`: the live session it was taken in, null outside one.

target.description: The workspace file the action writes, relative to the workspace root; for a VTT action, the document acted on, as the connector names it (a Foundry UUID).

before.description: The target's content before the action; null when absent. For a VTT action, the fields the VTT reported before it; null until it is taken.

after.description: The target's content after the action; null when deleted. For a VTT action, the fields asked for, then the ones the VTT reported after it.

status.description: pending at propose until approved or rejected; applied at once above propose; refused when the Core found the change contradicts canon (nothing written); failed when the VTT did not take it (ARC-09), with `error`; unknown for a VTT action while the GM client takes it, and after when it did not answer in time (with `error`), until a late answer settles it as applied or failed. A pending action whose call passes its deadline unanswered is rejected by the safe default (a `safe_default` entry).

refusal.description: Why the Core refused the action as a contradiction with canon; present only when `status` is refused. Counted as a continuity error (MET-01).

error.description: Why a failed action failed, or why an unknown one is.

approval.description: How a proposal was approved; null when none was needed or given.

quote.description: The GM's words, required via agent (DEL-28).

interaction.description: The gm_interaction entry recording the approval.

add_house_rule marks a discrepancy as intended, recording a named house rule that silences its kind of rules check, from an authenticated Surface only; remove_house_rule removes one (RUL-24); both carry it in `house_rule`, with `entry` null. add_override and remove_override add or remove an entity override (DEL-14, DEL-27), carried in `override`, with `entry` null; removing one is accepted only from an authenticated Surface. lift_hold and restore_hold lift or restore one delegation-table cell's irreversible hold (DEL-09a, DEL-27), carried in `hold`, with `entry` null; lifting is accepted only from an authenticated Surface. promote makes a hand edit a GM decision (CAN-11), from an authenticated Surface only; confirm promotes a fact or event recorded from the GM's words to the gm_decision rank (CAN-09, DEL-29); it is accepted only from an authenticated Surface and rewrites `target` from `before` to `after`.

entry.description: The action entry acted on; for confirm, the action or hand_edit entry that wrote the confirmed file, null when none did; for promote, the hand_edit entry promoted.

target.description: confirm only: the canon file it rewrites.

before.description: confirm only: that file's content before.

after.description: confirm only: that file's content after, at the gm_decision rank.

authenticated.description: Whether that Surface was authenticated (ARC-13): the CLI in an interactive terminal, or the Director's Desk.

quote.description: The GM's quoted words when relayed by an agent.

reason.description: The rejection reason (DEL-26), required for reject and undo.

override.description: add_override and remove_override only: the override added (at the level it holds after the addition, never looser than before) or removed.

house_rule.description: add_house_rule and remove_house_rule only: the house rule added or removed.

check.description: The kind of rules check it silences.

hold.description: lift_hold and restore_hold only: the cell whose hold was lifted or restored.

target.description: The canon file changed outside the Core, relative to the workspace root.

before.description: Its content as the Core last left it; null when the Core never wrote it.

after.description: Its content the rebuild found; null when it was deleted.

rank.description: The rank the index gives that content, whatever its front matter says: agent_proposal until promoted (CAN-11).

promotion.description: The gm_interaction entry that promoted it to a GM decision; null until then.

safe_default.description: A deadline passed unanswered (DEL-32, ARC-28): a proposal is rejected, an exception takes no action, a live job is missed. Shown again at the break. Also a call or queued job an entity override withdrew (DEL-16), which is not shown at the break.

call.description: The defaulted call (call.schema.json); null for a live job that missed its deadline.

entry.description: The proposal's action entry, now rejected; null otherwise.

job.description: The job the call came from, or the live job that missed its deadline or was withdrawn.

override.description: The add_override entry that withdrew the call or queued job (DEL-16); null when a deadline passed. Absent from entries written before entity overrides.
